description: This file provides functions for converting numbers to strings in various bases, including implementations of xtoa, itoa, and ultoa, along with test code for xtoa.

methods.name: void xtoa(unsigned long val,char * str,int base,int negative)
methods.description: Converts an unsigned long value to a string representation in a specified base, handling negative flag if needed.

methods.name: void ultoa(unsigned long value,char * str,int base)
methods.description: Converts an unsigned long to a string in a specified base, using xtoa with negative set to 0.

methods.name: char * itoa(int value,char * str,int base)
methods.description: Converts an integer to a string in a specified base, invoking xtoa and handling negativity.
